title: "Scratch"
output: html_document
---

Original edge flip

$$
E[\mathcal{M}_\epsilon(A)] = \frac{1}{e^\epsilon + 1}(\mathbf{1}_n \mathbf{1}_n^T - I_n) + \frac{e^\epsilon - 1}{e^\epsilon + 1}A
$$

$$
Var[\mathcal{M}_\epsilon(A)] = \frac{e^\epsilon}{(e^\epsilon + 1)^2}
$$

Adjusted edge flip

$$
\mathcal{AdjustedM}_\epsilon(A) = [\mathcal{M}_\epsilon(A) - \frac{(\mathbf{1}_n \mathbf{1}_n^T - I_n)}{(e^\epsilon + 1)}]\frac{(e^\epsilon + 1)}{(e^\epsilon - 1)}
$$

$$
E[\mathcal{AdjustedM}_\epsilon(A)] = A
$$

$$
Var[\mathcal{M}_\epsilon(A)] = \frac{e^\epsilon}{(e^\epsilon - 1)^2}
$$

Error bound of Laplacian matrix when using Spectral Sparsification on top of EdgeFlip. The Expectation is only over the randomness from EdgeFlip

$$
(1 - \beta) L_\text{Edge Flip} \preceq L_\text{Spectral Sparsification}  \preceq (1 + \beta) L_\text{Edge Flip} \\
=> (1 - \beta)E(L_\text{Edge Flip}) \preceq E(L_\text{Spectral Sparsification}) \preceq (1 + \beta) E(L_\text{Edge Flip}) \\
=> (1 - \beta)(\frac{1}{e^\epsilon + 1}(nI_n-\mathbf{1}_n \mathbf{1}_n^T) + \frac{e^\epsilon - 1}{e^\epsilon + 1}L_\text{original}) \preceq E(L_\text{Spectral Sparsification}) \preceq (1 + \beta) (\frac{1}{e^\epsilon + 1}(nI_n-\mathbf{1}_n \mathbf{1}_n^T) + \frac{e^\epsilon - 1}{e^\epsilon + 1}L_\text{original}) \\
\text{Adjusting the output of "Edge Flip + Spectral Sparsification" like how we adjust the output of just "Edge Flip" will lead to this error bound} \\
=> (1 - \beta)L_\text{original} - \beta \frac{(nI_n-\mathbf{1}_n \mathbf{1}_n^T)}{e^\epsilon - 1} \preceq E(L_\text{Spectral Sparsification Adjusted}) \preceq (1 + \beta)L_\text{original} + \beta \frac{(nI_n-\mathbf{1}_n \mathbf{1}_n^T)}{e^\epsilon - 1}
$$
